map.朝代对比口径：存续年数 = 结束年 − 开始年；同期对照以公元纪年为轴，标出各朝: Dynasty comparison basis: duration = end year − start year; synchronous comparison uses the Gregorian year as axis, marking each dynasty's start order and overlap interval; the span can be converted to the ratio of China's recorded history length (about 2070 BCE to present, about 4100 years). Population comparison first normalizes units: ten thousands (1×10⁴) and hundred millions (1×10⁸), then computes the ratio as the first selected dynasty's population ÷ the second selected dynasty's population, reporting both the percentage and the multiple.
map.备课或写作业时快速核对两个朝代的起止年代与存续时长，例如唐朝 618–907 共: Quickly verify the start/end eras and durations of two dynasties when preparing lessons or homework, e.g. Tang 618–907 (289 years), Ming 1368–1644 (276 years).
map.比较分裂割据时期的并存政权：选「三国(220–280)」与「晋朝(266–420: Compare coexisting regimes in divided periods: select "Three Kingdoms (220–280)" and "Jin (266–420)", the tool computes a 14-year overlap (266–280) of the two regimes.
map.制作时间轴或对比表时，直接取开国君主、都城、疆域、人口等字段，避免逐个翻年表。: When making a timeline or comparison table, take fields like founding monarch, capital, territory and population directly, avoiding flipping through chronologies one by one.
map.唐(618–907，289 年) vs 明(1368–1644，276 年)：无: Tang (618–907, 289 years) vs Ming (1368–1644, 276 years): no time overlap, duration difference 13 years. If Zhou (−1046–−256, 790 years) vs Qin (−221–−206, 15 years): Zhou ends at −256 earlier than Qin starts at −221, no overlap, Zhou is 775 years longer than Qin. If Three Kingdoms (220–280) vs Jin (266–420): overlap 266–280 totals 14 years.
map.朝代起止年为什么常用「约」？: Why are dynasty start/end years often marked "approximate"?
map.早期王朝（夏、商、周）年代多据文献与「夏商周断代工程」推定，存在学术区间；秦以后: Early dynasties (Xia, Shang, Zhou) dates are mostly inferred from documents and the Xia-Shang-Zhou Chronology Project, with academic ranges; after Qin the chronology is more certain, but divided periods (Three Kingdoms, Northern and Southern Dynasties) take regime founding or unification as the boundary, and different general histories may differ.
map.当两个所选朝代的时间轴有交集时显示重叠年数，主要用于分裂割据时期，例如魏蜀吴与西: When the two selected dynasties timelines intersect, the overlap years are shown, mainly for divided periods, e.g. Wei-Shu-Wu and early Western Jin, Northern and Southern Dynasties and surrounding regimes. Unified dynasties generally do not overlap.
map.工具和史书年份为何有出入？: Why do the tool and history books years differ?
map.本工具以单一权威年表为准（含断代工程取值），不同教材或通史可能取整或采用异说，属: This tool follows a single authoritative chronology (including Chronology Project values); different textbooks or general histories may round or adopt alternative accounts, which is a normal difference; when citing, follow the convention of the textbook you use.

map.选择两个朝代即可看到起止年代、存续年数、并存重叠区间与人口比值，并附开国君主、都: Pick two dynasties to see their start and end years, duration, overlapping period and population ratio, plus founding ruler and capital; BCE years are handled as negative values.
map.存续时长 = 结束年 − 开始年；并存期 = 较早的结束年 − 较晚的开始年，结: Duration = end year − start year; overlap = earlier end year − later start year, with a positive result indicating overlap. BCE years are represented as negative numbers, for example Xia starts at −2070 (2070 BCE).
map.朝代对比口径：存续年数 = 结束年 − 开始年；区间跨越公元前后的分界时再减 1: Comparison basis: duration = end year − start year; subtract one more year when the range crosses the BCE/CE boundary because historical chronology has no year zero. Overlap and start-year gaps use the same rule. Population is normalized (10,000 = 1×10⁴, 100 million = 1×10⁸) and expressed as a ratio, labeled with its reference year and estimation basis; the ratio is only an order-of-magnitude comparison.
map.比较分裂割据时期的并存政权：选「三国(220–280)」与「晋朝(266–420: Compare coexisting regimes in divided periods: select “Three Kingdoms (220–280)” and “Jin (266–420)”; the tool applies the no-year-zero chronology and reports a 14-year overlap from 266 to 280.
map.制作时间轴或对比表时，导出当前所选两个朝代的完整明细；人口与疆域字段附带统计约年: When building a timeline or comparison table, export the full details of the two selected dynasties. Population and territory fields include reference years, estimate ranges and data notes so different scopes are not treated as exact multiples.
map.存续年数 = 结束年 − 开始年；若跨越公元前后的分界，再减 1 年（历史纪年没: Duration = end year − start year; subtract one more year when the range crosses the BCE/CE boundary because historical chronology has no year zero. For example, Han from 202 BCE to 220 CE = 202 + 220 − 1 = 421 years, not 422. Overlap periods use the same rule.
map.跨公元前后的年数为什么少 1 年？: Why is a BCE–CE span one year shorter?
map.历史纪年从公元前 1 年直接进入公元 1 年，没有公元 0 年。因此从公元前 2: Historical chronology moves directly from 1 BCE to 1 CE; there is no year zero. So 202 BCE to 220 CE is 202 + 220 − 1 = 421 years. Founding gaps, overlaps and durations all use the same rule.
map.人口倍数能直接当精确结论吗？: Can the population ratio be treated as an exact conclusion?
map.不能。各朝人口是不同学者对高峰期或特定年份的估算，统计范围、在册人口与隐户处理不: No. Population figures are scholarly estimates for a peak period or a specific year, and reporting scope, registered households and treatment of unregistered people differ. The tool labels the reference year and estimation basis; use the ratio only as an order-of-magnitude comparison and verify the source before citing it.
